summary: Two ATV riders became separated from their group while descending from Lost Lake; Vail Mountain Rescue Group dispatched two team members, but the riders were reunited with their party while rescuers were en route; all out of the field by 6:30 p.m. without injury.
notes: Run-577 insert: Edward Stoner/Vail Daily mission-digest repost (vailchamber.org), parent-opened this run; Sept./Oct. VMRG digest posted 2014-11-08.
